name: scout
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production miniature isometric RTS vehicle sprite atlas, landscape 2:1 image, exact 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, true transparent RGBA.
Create the SAME original modern desert scout 4x4 armored car in eight physically rotated yaw views. Premium detailed 3D miniature, fixed orthographic camera elevated 45 degrees, soft neutral daylight. Sand-beige matte armored panels, four black rubber tires, angular hood, small roof machine gun turret, blue-gray armored windows, spare tire at rear, tiny seams and vents. Clear silhouette at game scale; restrained realistic material wear. All eight are the exact same vehicle under the same lighting and camera.
Exact row order: top E (hood RIGHT), NE (hood UPPER RIGHT), N (hood UP away, rear facing viewer), NW (hood UPPER LEFT). Bottom W (hood LEFT), SW (hood LOWER LEFT), S (hood DOWN toward viewer), SE (hood LOWER RIGHT). Rotate the vehicle, do not mirror a sprite. Keep each complete vehicle centered in its equal square cell with ALL parts inside the central 62 percent, including gun barrel; wide transparent padding on all sides. Identical physical scale, naturally narrow front/rear views.
Alpha zero background and gutters. Neutral antialiasing. No ground, cast shadows, smoke, desert, grid, labels, text, watermark, checkerboard, flags, glowing outlines or separate objects. Only eight clean isolated detailed vehicle sprites.

name: artillery
prompt:
Production isometric strategy game sprite sheet of ONE original desert self-propelled artillery vehicle, in EIGHT different directions. Exact 4 columns and 2 rows of equal square cells on a transparent background. Fixed elevated orthographic camera looking 45 degrees down. Matte tan tracked hull, wide continuous rubber tracks, long narrow howitzer barrel, boxy rear turret, hatches, vents and bolt details, realistic miniature craftsmanship. One coherent design and identical scale across the eight views. Soft neutral studio lighting, no outline, no glow, no rim light.
Top row: 1 barrel points RIGHT; 2 barrel points UPPER RIGHT away, rear of vehicle nearest lower left; 3 barrel points UP away, rear nearest bottom; 4 barrel points UPPER LEFT away, rear nearest lower right. Bottom row: 5 barrel LEFT; 6 barrel LOWER LEFT toward viewer; 7 barrel DOWN toward viewer; 8 barrel LOWER RIGHT toward viewer. Entire vehicle and its barrel must fit within middle 62% of its cell. Exactly centered with generous transparent gutters on all four sides. No cropping, no shadows, no smoke, no ground, no white matte, no checkerboard, no text, no grid, no flags. True alpha-zero empty background. Color palette limited to beige tan dark charcoal neutral metal; no red yellow green blue saturated pixels on edges.
